confirmed_findings.statement: SBI VC Trade offers XRP in its scheduled accumulation service: JPY 500–2,000,000 per order, daily/weekly/monthly, with customer JPY prefunding.
SBI VISA Crypto Card points automatically convert monthly into one selected asset among BTC, ETH and XRP; base rewards are 0.5% Standard and 1.0% Gold.
Five SBI Group entities documented 2026 shareholder-benefit programs that can deliver XRP through SBI VC Trade accounts.
An official SBI Group affiliate release describes SBI Holdings as a Ripple investor and strategic partner and states that SBI Ripple Asia was established in 2016.
The September–October 2026 card acquisition campaign was closed in Japan by the 2026-11-01 02:07 JST capture; ordinary card reward mechanics remain separate.

inferences: The combined DCA, card and multi-affiliate shareholder programs form a plausible SBI Group retail distribution and customer-onboarding funnel into SBI VC Trade.
The customer-funded DCA product is a potential recurring purchase channel; the card and shareholder programs are reward/distribution channels with different capital semantics.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI VC Trade's scheduled accumulation product can create recurring customer-funded XRP purchase demand when customers select XRP and maintain sufficient JPY balances.
support: Official product terms specify XRP eligibility, scheduled frequencies, JPY order limits and required prefunding.
disconfirming: No active-plan counts, filled XRP units, execution venue or external sourcing is disclosed.
Insufficient balance can skip orders; the dealer may internalize or source inventory away from public spot books.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Obtain XRP-specific plan counts, monthly JPY order/fill totals and execution/inventory reconciliation.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI Group's card and multi-affiliate shareholder-benefit programs may expand XRP ownership and onboard customers into SBI VC Trade.
support: Five SBI entities documented XRP shareholder benefits; receipt requires an SBI VC Trade account.
The card converts points into selected crypto-assets, including XRP.
SBI Insurance Group explicitly describes improving awareness and understanding of the SBI Group as a program objective.
disconfirming: No participant counts, XRP selection shares, coupon redemptions or XRP units credited are disclosed.
Some benefits are optional and can be exchanged for non-crypto products.
Rewards may be fulfilled from existing inventory rather than new market purchases.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Obtain eligible-holder counts, redemption rates, XRP units credited and inventory source-of-funds records.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Card points and shareholder XRP coupons may be fulfilled through existing dealer inventory or internal transfers without equivalent contemporaneous public-market buying.
support: Reward conversion uses an SBI VC Trade displayed sales-price reference, not a disclosed external execution record.
The programs specify fixed JPY benefit values and same-name account credits.
disconfirming: If SBI VC Trade replenishes inventory externally, some reward fulfillment could induce spot or OTC demand; no procurement evidence is published.
competing_hypotheses.next_test: Reconcile reward liabilities, treasury inventory and exchange/OTC purchase records over the benefit settlement windows.
